questions.question: A circle is inscribed in a quadrilateral ABCD touching sides AB, BC, CD and AD at the points P, Q, R and S, respectively. If BP = 4 cm, SD = 6 and BC = 7 cm, then the length of DC is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91568c46a202d0442497fd6483bd9dd3f16491a6b03edd7fc041c4bb6d24a527.png] 

Given, SD = 6 cm, BP = 4 cm, BC = 7 cm

As we know,

BP = BQ = 4 [∵ Tangent to the circle]

⇒ BC = BQ + QC

⇒ 7 = 4 + QC

⇒ QC = 3

⇒ SD = DR = 6 [∵ Tangent to the circle]

⇒ QC = RC = 3 [∵ Tangent to the circle]

⇒ DC = DR + RC = 6 + 3 = 9 cm

questions.question: If x = 2 – p, then x³ + 6xp + p³ is equal to:

⇒ x = 2 – P,

⇒ x + P = 2

⇒ (x + P)³ = 2³

⇒ x³ + P³ + 3xP (x + P) = 8

⇒ x³ + P³ = 8 – 3px(x + P)

Now,

⇒ x³ + 6xP + P³

⇒ x³ + P³ + 6xP

⇒ 8 – 3px (x + P) + 6xP

Put x = 2 – P

⇒ 8 – 3P(2 – P)(2 – P + P) + 6(2 – P)P

⇒ 8 – 12P + 6P² + 12P – 6P²

A dealer buys an article at a discount of 20% on its list price and marks it at 25% above the list price. If he allows a 20% discount on the new list price, then his profit percent is:
questions.solution:
Let the price of the article be 100x.

Dealer bought the article at 20% discount, then

CP of the article for the dealer = 100x × [80/100] = 80x

Marked price of the article = 100x × [125/100] = 125x

SP of the article after 20% discount = 125x × [80/100] = 100x

∴ Required profit percentage = [(100x – 80x)/80x] × 100 = 25%

questions.question: The ratio of the efficiencies of A, B and C is 7 : 5 : 8. Working together, they can complete a piece of work in 42 days. B and C worked together for 21 days and the remaining work was completed by A alone. The whole work was completed in:
questions.solution:
Efficiency ratio of A, B and C = 7 : 5 : 8

Total work = 42 × (7 + 5 + 8) = 840

Work done by B and C in 21 days = (5 + 8) × 21 = 273

Remaining work = 840 – 273 = 567

Remaining work A will complete in = 567/7 = 81 days

Total time = 21 + 81 = 102 days

questions.question: Three numbers are such that if the average of any two of them is added to the third number, the sums obtained are 164, 158 and 132 respectively. What is the average of the original three numbers?
questions.solution:
Suppose there are three number a, b and c.

According to the question

⇒ a + (b + c)/2 = 164

⇒ 2a + b + c = 164 × 2 = 328 ----(1)

⇒ b + (c + a)/2 = 158

⇒ 2b + c + a = 158 × 2 = 316 ----(2)

⇒ c + (a + b)/2 = 132

⇒ 2c + a + b = 264 ----(3)

Add equation (1), (2) and (3)

⇒ 4(a + b + c) = 908

⇒ a + b + c = 227

∴ Required average = 227/3 = 75(2)/(3)

questions.question: If x⁴ – 6x² – 1 = 0, then the value of x⁶ – 5x² + 5/x² – 1/x⁶ + 5 is:
questions.solution:
**__Identity Used__:**

(a - b)³ = a³ - b³ - 3ab (a - b)

**__Calculation__:**

x⁴ – 6x² – 1 = 0

⇒ x² – 6 – 1/x² = 0

⇒ x² – 1/x² = 6

From the above expression, we can obtain x6 – 1/x6 by using Identity mentioned above as:

⇒ (x⁶ – 1/x⁶) = (x² – 1/x²)³ + 3(x² – 1/x²)

⇒ x⁶ – 1/x⁶ = 6³ + 3 × 6 = 216 + 18 = 234

⇒ x⁶ – 5x² + 5/x² – 1/x⁶ + 5

⇒ x⁶ – 1/x⁶ – 5(x² – 1/x²) + 5

⇒ 234 – 5 × 6 + 5

⇒ 239 – 30

⇒ 20

If a 10-digit number 1330x558y2 is divisible by 88, then the value of (x + y) is:
questions.solution:
10 digit number 1330x558y2 is divisible by 88, means number is also divisible by 11 and 8

⇒ Sum of digit of the number even place = 3 + 0 + 5 + 8 + 2 = 18

⇒ Sum of digit of the number odd place = 1 + 3 + x + 5 + y = 9 + x + y

As we know,

⇒ 9 + (x + y) – 18 = 0

⇒ x + y = 9
